annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. Department of Homeland Security (Federal Protective Service)
annotation.venue: Code of Federal Regulations (6 CFR Part 139)
annotation.summary_en: US Department of Homeland Security regulation setting conduct rules on federal property protected by the Federal Protective Service. It covers screening, prohibited conduct, vehicles and penalties. Only incidental physical-system provisions: unmanned aircraft takeoff, landing and interference are restricted, and vehicles include autonomously operated ones.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bars launching or landing unmanned aircraft on federal property without permission from the Facility Security Committee, Designated Official, or responsible agency.
Prohibits using unmanned aircraft to interfere with, damage or endanger federal property or persons.
Prohibits tampering with computers, networks, industrial control systems or SCADA without authorization.
Defines 'vehicle' to include autonomously operated vehicles.
Violations are punishable by a fine, up to 30 days' imprisonment, or both.
